name: Piclo
notes: Runs the Piclo Flex marketplace. Northern Powergrid uses it end to end, from qualification to dispatch and settlement (SRC-0012, PDF p.10); NGED uses it as a second route into its markets (SRC-0011, PDF p.6). Legal entity not confirmed from a primary source: Companies House lists Open Utility Ltd (08384033, incorporated 2013) and Piclo Ltd (14266869, incorporated 2022) at the same registered office, and secondary sources say Open Utility Ltd operates Piclo. registry_id left blank until confirmed. piclo.energy redirects to piclo.com, which reset the connection in this run.

name: Chaddenwych Services Limited
notes: Trades as Electron (SRC-0058) and runs the ElectronConnect platform. SPEN selected it after a competitive tender (SRC-0013, PDF p.10); SPENW has used it since March 2024 (SRC-0014, PDF p.20); SSEN uses it for qualification, contracting and bidding (SRC-0015, PDF p.14). Companies House 09914060: private limited company, incorporated 14 December 2015, active.

name: Flexible Power
notes: A joint initiative of four DNOs (NGED, Northern Powergrid, SSEN and SP Energy Networks), not a company, so no registry_id. Its website says the Flexible Power trademark is wholly owned by NGED (ORG-0014) (SRC-0057, archived 15 January 2026). Used by NGED (SRC-0011) and SSEN (SRC-0015, SRC-0056) for dispatch and settlement.
